panels.title: Figure 2: Distribution of note-level prediction outcomes, grouped by clinical problem and by which methods were correct.
notes: Grouped vertical bar chart (matplotlib): 3 clinical problems on x, 4 outcome series per group in legend order (green, red, blue, amber), the count printed above every bar. All 12 values are the printed counts (source 'printed', confidence 1.0, label_printed verbatim).

Read from the PDF's embedded bitmap (page 5, one RGB image 1390 x 795 px, 5.79 px per PDF point; no vector paths or text layer in the figure). Y calibration: least squares through the 8 horizontal gridlines / frame lines at native y = 742, 638, 534, 430, 326, 223, 119, 15 px for 0, 50, ..., 350 -> 2.077 px per case; fit residual <= 0.5 px (0.25 cases).

Check that every label belongs to its bar: all 12 bar tops were measured (top edge of the bar's colour run on its centre column) and converted with the calibration; largest |measured - printed| = 0.38 cases (0.15% of the 0-350 axis), every bar within 0.4 of its label.
Congestive Heart Failure / MAS Correct, Baseline Incorrect: bar x 126-210, top edge y 715 -> 13.1 vs printed '13'
Congestive Heart Failure / MAS Incorrect, Baseline Correct: bar x 211-295, top edge y 729 -> 6.4 vs printed '6'
Congestive Heart Failure / Both Correct: bar x 296-381, top edge y 121 -> 299.2 vs printed '299'
Congestive Heart Failure / Both Incorrect: bar x 382-466, top edge y 530 -> 102.2 vs printed '102'
Acute Kidney Injury / MAS Correct, Baseline Incorrect: bar x 552-637, top edge y 690 -> 25.2 vs printed '25'
Acute Kidney Injury / MAS Incorrect, Baseline Correct: bar x 638-722, top edge y 690 -> 25.2 vs printed '25'
Acute Kidney Injury / Both Correct: bar x 723-807, top edge y 212 -> 255.4 vs printed '255'
Acute Kidney Injury / Both Incorrect: bar x 808-893, top edge y 503 -> 115.2 vs printed '115'
Sepsis / MAS Correct, Baseline Incorrect: bar x 979-1063, top edge y 690 -> 25.2 vs printed '25'
Sepsis / MAS Incorrect, Baseline Correct: bar x 1064-1149, top edge y 688 -> 26.1 vs printed '26'
Sepsis / Both Correct: bar x 1150-1234, top edge y 154 -> 283.3 vs printed '283'
Sepsis / Both Incorrect: bar x 1235-1319, top edge y 563 -> 86.3 vs printed '86'

Each group sums to 420 notes (13+6+299+102, 25+25+255+115, 25+26+283+86). Agreement with the paper text (page 5): for sepsis the text gives MAS TP 99 / FN 30 / FP 82 and baseline TP 96 / FN 33 / FP 78; with 420 notes that is 308 correct for MAS and 309 for the baseline, equal to 283+25 and 283+26 from the bars.

Legend glyphs: a small white circle (recorded as U+25CB) and a multiplication sign (recorded as U+00D7); the figure is a bitmap, so the exact code points are a reading of the glyph shapes. Y axis runs 0-350 (top frame line at 350), ticks every 50; x tick labels are the three clinical problems; axis titles 'Clinical Problem' and 'Number of Cases' are printed in bold.

uncertain: No printed panel title: panel.title carries the figure caption (as in the Cardiologent truth).

Series names are the legend entries verbatim, including the parenthesised marks; the circle and cross glyphs are transcribed as U+25CB and U+00D7 from a bitmap (a prediction using 'O'/'x' or other look-alikes differs by 2 characters and still matches under the scorer's 0.2 Levenshtein rule).

Scorer caveat: the legend names are pairwise within the scorer's fuzzy-match distance ('MAS Correct, Baseline Incorrect ...' vs 'MAS Incorrect, Baseline Correct ...': 6 of 47 characters = 0.13; 'Both Correct (○)' vs 'Both Incorrect (×)': 3 of 18 = 0.17; both <= 0.2, checked with evidence.same_label). scoring._match_values pairs each truth row with the first unused prediction row that passes, so a prediction listing the series in legend order (as the truth does) pairs correctly, but one listing red before green, or amber before blue, within a category can be cross-paired and scored as wrong although its values are right.

figure.bbox is copied verbatim from the picture's prov in document.json (l, t, r, b with coord_origin BOTTOMLEFT, as in the existing truth files); bbox_px is in pixels of the bundle crop. The single panel is the whole 359 x 205 crop.
